description: Elections Commission - The Industrial Disputes between U. R. Sellahewa Kirinda Pubulwella and other part Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka Narahenpita Colombo 05
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute. It references specific legislative acts (Chapter 131, Act Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962, 39 of 1968, and 37 of 1968) and exercises powers vested by that legislation. While it names the Minister making the appointment, the core content is about implementing a legal/regulatory framework for dispute resolution, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for matters involving legal frameworks, regulations, and statutory instruments.
